title: Harry Potter Trivia
shortDescription: Harry Potter Trivia with Four Dogs Entertainment at The Mill at Fountain Inn. Free to play.
description: Bring your fellow Harry Potter fans to The Mill at Fountain Inn for Harry Potter Trivia with Four Dogs Entertainment. Team up with friends, test your knowledge of the wizarding world, and enjoy a hosted night of friendly competition. Trivia is free to play; food and drinks are purchased separately.
instructions: Contact the venue for seating or participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
